title: Implement per-peer inbound article rate limiter (token bucket)
description:
Implement a per-peer token bucket rate limiter: configurable articles/second per peer, burst size, and what happens on exhaustion (respond 431 'slow down' or drop connection). Rate limit state stored in-memory, not persisted. Artifact: transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs.

Acceptance: rate limiter enforces articles/second limit; burst handling correct; exhaustion response is configurable; unit test: send 1000 articles at 10x rate, verify rejection count matches expected
